description: This Java class, DateTimeUtil, provides utility functions and formatters for handling ISO 8601 date-time strings with time zone information, including parsing and creating various date-time formatter configurations.

classes.name: DateTimeUtil
classes.description: A utility class for creating and managing ISO 8601 compliant date-time formatters and parsing date-time strings into OffsetDateTime objects.

methods.name: parseOffsetDateTime
methods.description: Parses a string into an OffsetDateTime object using a predefined formatter supporting multiple ISO 8601 formats.
